### 2026-10-08 – I researched the right RTC to use on this project, condlucing that the DS3231MZ+ would be the best option for this project, then I downloaded the sym files as well as the pretty files for the symbols

**1.5h**

I researched the right RTC to use on this project, condlucing that the DS3231MZ+ would be the best option for this project, then I downloaded the sym files as well as the pretty files for the symbols library as well as the footprint library, then i researched the xiao pins config to know what i could use for it, the i opened kicad, added the RTC to it and weired, then updated it to the pcb and connected everything, debugging a few errors on the DRC ( as well as finding space to wire it) , after all that I still looked at the firware code to check if i could somewhere add the buzzer and the RTC to it but didnt find any easy way.
